findings.title: Model Router Call Log File Missing

evidence.observation: Model router is active on port 8891, but call_log_exists is false for /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl.

proposed_action.description: Ensure model router runtime process has permissions to create and write call metrics to call_log.jsonl.

findings.expected_benefit: Enables historical auditability, latency tracking, and fallback analytics for model invocations.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: observability_gap; Evidence strength: strong; Confidence: 0.85; Risk: low; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Changes to running services require verification

findings.title: Emergency Alert Pipeline Directly Calls Gemini and Mistral APIs

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini and call_mistral with environment variable keys bypassing the central model router.

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM synthesis tasks through the model router via dedicated task types rather than direct SDK/HTTP calls.

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes rate limiting, failover policies, and token usage accounting.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: router_bypass; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Router bypasses must be corrected by design review
